services.desc: Purpose-built and battle-tested, the Bigeye is set up from bow to stern for one mission: killing tuna. Outfitted with over 35 heavy-duty rod holders, full tuna tower, below deck fish holds and oversize engines, she’s optimized for long offshore runs and nonstop hook-ups. With a storied track record of epic hauls, the Bigeye carries a legacy of consistent success-and she’s ready to write the next chapter with you on deck.
